evals.prompt: 对 Phase-N 冻结契约做最终只读一致性审查，返回 PASS/FAIL。
evals.expected_output: Builds the checklist from frozen items, traces each through all normative documents with doc:line evidence, classifies omission vs contradiction.
assertions: Traces every item across all documents

evals.prompt: 对照 SRS AC / ADR / HLD 清单逐项验证实现与测试，输出 PASS/FAIL。
evals.expected_output: Runs spec-compliance mode: reads implementation fully, maps every AC to a test by name, runs focused suites, reports real pass counts.
assertions: Maps ACs to tests by name
Runs focused test suites as execution evidence

evals.prompt: 验证冻结的公共 API manifest（命名空间、可空性、枚举值）与 ADR 和计划一致。
evals.expected_output: Diffs the frozen manifest against the plan's API sketch and PublicAPI baseline char-for-char.
assertions: Checks additive enum values state = N

evals.prompt: 上线前的契约冻结验证，检查禁止的需求 ID 和删除的 API 名。
evals.expected_output: Greps negative claims over the whole docs tree and verifies forbidden IDs have zero hits.
assertions: Greps the whole docs tree for forbidden IDs
Verifies removed API names appear only as removal statements

evals.prompt: 审计详细设计 SD-* 条目的可验证性与术语一致性。
evals.expected_output: Routes design-entry quality auditing to ada-detailed-design-audit.

evals.prompt: 审计文档与源码实现的漂移。
比较两份文档版本的差异。
编写项目背景文档作为 SRS 前置输入。
evals.expected_output: Treats this as document authoring, not contract consistency review.
assertions: Does not activate read-only contract review
